qa_pairs.question: What special tool is required to remove the spring strut assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 31 3 000 is required to remove the spring strut assembly and take up spring strut in a vise.

qa_pairs.question: What important note is given when a correction mount is used?
qa_pairs.answer: If a correction mount (see Group 32) is used, install a new mount with the same code.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is needed to set up the mount for spring compression?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 31 3 116 should be set up on the mount for spring compression.

qa_pairs.question: Which special tool is used specifically for All Wheel Drive Cars when setting up the mount?
qa_pairs.answer: For All Wheel Drive Cars, Special Tool 31 3 117 is used to set up on the mount.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure for removing the guide sleeve and special tool compressor?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove washer (2), screw in guide sleeve 31 3 115 entire length of threads, then release and remove special tool compressor.

qa_pairs.question: In what order are the components installed when lifting off the mount?
qa_pairs.answer: The installed order is: 1 Self-locking nut, 2 Washer with small diameter, 3 Mount, 4 Seal, 5 Washer with large diameter, 6 Cap.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is used to compress the coil spring?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 31 3 111 is used to compress coil spring.

qa_pairs.question: What important safety note is given when using the spring compressor?
qa_pairs.answer: Pins must fit in openings when compressing the coil spring with Special Tool 31 3 111.

qa_pairs.question: How should the self-locking nut be removed from the strut mount?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off cap and unscrew self-locking nut with Special Tool 31 3 170.

qa_pairs.question: What is the installation procedure for the self-locking nut?
qa_pairs.answer: Replace self-locking nut and tighten to specified torque.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked during installation of the upper spring retainer?
qa_pairs.answer: Check upper and lower rubber rings, replacing if necessary. Ends of coil spring must rest on shoulders in lower and upper spring retainers.

qa_pairs.question: Which direction should the internal curved surface of the seal face?
qa_pairs.answer: The internal curved surface of seal (4) faces the mount.
